nature: Post-outcome exploratory fixed-state threshold sensitivity; the original DV and k-sensitivity outcomes were already known.
rank_selection: Every integer rank 234 through 259, inclusive; no point selected using evaluation outcomes.
threshold_formula: anchor * sorted(original_outer_peak / anchor)[rank-1]; strict score > threshold
rank_reference_probability: (260-rank)/260; an ideal continuous exchangeable marginal reference, not an equal realized or true FAR guarantee.
normal_FAR_horizon: All 960 records (48 hours), exactly as original DV.
clean_detection: No alarm in first160 records AND a postfault alarm by the indicated horizon; all250 runs retained.
horizon_losses: For H in {120,480,2400}, loss=first_postfault_delay if clean and delay<=H, else H. Original DV primary loss is H=2400.
normalization_warning: H is a finite-window scoring convention, not a measured industrial economic cost.

intervals.rates: two-sided marginal95% Clopper-Pearson conditional on frozen state and independent Bernoulli runs
intervals.contrasts: 20000 paired whole-run percentile bootstrap; moment minus mean at each common calibration rank; common schedule across ranks; distinct schedules for normal and fault roles.
intervals.bootstrap_generator: NumPy PCG64; seed=first8bytes(SHA256(protocol_id + | + role)), big endian

no_interpolation_or_matching: No empirical-FAR threshold selection, interpolation or equivalence claim. Same rank is not same true FAR.
report_all: All26 ranks,52 method-rank rows, adverse outcomes, per-run events and full curves.
execution_order: Write all52 thresholds BEFORE reading either test role
Replay normal/fault test scores and require original rank247 bitmaps exact
Recheck input files and create return archive
abort: Any integrity, shape, baseline or numeric failure stops; never repair original files or retune to pass.
outputs: New unique output directory only. No simulation, training, installations, network, Git/Zenodo changes or original replacement.
